scientific_integrity: New proof provides exact finite lower witnesses, a global continuous sharp bound and compactness-based asymptotic rigidity. Computational checks are finite diagnostics, not certifications of infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Real coefficients and one moment; asymptotic sharpness and strong limiting profile only. No exact all-finite-dimension optimizer theorem, higher difference result or complex-valued extension. Priority under alternative names is not definitively excluded.
title: Sharp zero-moment discrete Sobolev limit and two-lobe rigidity
